first: The dust hung thick over the arena floor as the protective barrier shone brightly before slowly fading away. Through the swirling haze, Roland’s sensors pierced the smoke and locked onto the white knight frame. It stood upright near the edge of the crater, its shield still raised, and its front armor plates scorched black but intact. Robert’s voice came through the internal channel, steady, though slightly strained.
last: He watched as the students vanished one by one through the dimensional doors. Various teams appeared on the screen, including his sister’s. They were finally nearing the end. Just one more event, and it would all be over.
